notes: GAAP report: governmental funds on modified cash basis, business-type funds on accrual basis. Governmental: Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds (p5-6, report p18, added by the find_pages v8 re-trim) gives the printed totals: revenues 2,816,066, expenditures 3,511,494, transfers in 840,892, transfers out 520,976, fund balances 2,723,869 -> 2,348,357 (identity ties). Receipt lines are per fund: General Fund lines from the General Fund Departments combining schedule (p23-24 Total column; finer than the statement, same 889,679 total: statement Intergovernmental 261,326 = state assistance 257,051 + rural fire 4,275; Charges for services 80,318 = rental and fees 63,539 + admission fees 14,346 + licenses and permits 2,433), Street p17, Sales Tax p18, Economic Development p20, Grant p21, Nonmajor Total column p22, and the Community Development Agency Fund column of the statement (p5; also its budget schedule p19). General Fund disbursements are the statement's function lines (p5), which separate capital outlay 167,547 and debt service 32,796 from the departments; department/object detail stays in detail[] from p23-24. Other funds' spending lines match the statement columns. The CDA Fund (TIF proceeds 248,373, economic development 724,374, transfers out 2,624) was previously missing; its budget schedule (p19) is now in detail, and its transfer out 2,624 explains the former difference between governmental net transfers and the business-type transfers (319,916 both sides now). ending_fund_balance 2,348,357 and ending_cash (cash and cash equivalents 229,604; county treasurer cash 19,997 not included) are from the p4 Balance Sheet, Total Governmental Funds; beginning cash is not printed. Balance sheet recorded from the government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1) Total column (primary government); governmental activities and component units are separate columns not used. Interfund notes receivable/payable appear in both assets and liabilities as printed. Business-type: Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position (p9-10) Total column (includes the Allocated Administration column, whose expense allocation nets to zero in total); receipts = operating revenues 5,797,856 + nonoperating interest 30,551, grant revenue 1,063,191, miscellaneous 2,693; disbursements = operating expenses 5,592,991 (allocated administrative expenses net to 0 and are not listed) + interest expense 15,664 + loan administration fees 12,106 = 5,620,761. Net position 19,090,043 + 6,894,291 - 5,620,761 - 319,916 transfers = 20,043,657. Proprietary cash flows from p11-12 Total column (p13-14 operating reconciliation ties to 1,232,169). Transfers: Electric (238,047) and Natural Gas (81,869) to governmental funds = 319,916. General Fund Transfers in 428,669 (p16 budget schedule; department split on p24 is not repeated). General Fund revenue detail: department columns from p23-24 (superset of the p15 budget schedule, whose budget column is therefore not captured per line; budget total resources 855,241). No double counting between p15 and p23-24 in detail (only p23-24 recorded for General Fund revenue/spending). General Fund budget schedule shows transfers out 0 actual. Street Fund loan proceeds and Sales Tax/other budget-only lines have no actual and are not recorded.
